h1:
Where to stay in
Nang Thong & Bang Niang (Khao Lak)
intro: When people say Khao Lak, most mean this stretch. Nang Thong sits in the middle and is the busiest part, with a main road full of seafood restaurants, Western eateries, small bars, massage shops and souvenir stalls. Just north is Bang Niang, which has a night market open several days a week and a slightly more laid-back feel. The two beaches are walkable or a few minutes apart by car. Khao Lak's draw is a quiet, wide beach with no all-night party scene like Patong, so it works well for families, couples and anyone who wants a real rest. Peak season is November to April; the rainy months (May to October) bring stronger surf and some resort closures, but prices drop a lot. One thing to know: Khao Lak has no real public transport, so you will mostly rent a car or scooter, or call a taxi.

blocks.html: Short answer: Nang Thong and Bang Niang form the heart of Khao Lak, the walkable strip with restaurants, massage shops, convenience stores and the Bang Niang market. Stays run from cheap roadside guesthouses to 5-star beachfront resorts. It suits travellers who want a calm beach but still want food and shops within easy reach.

blocks.text: Recommended hotels in Nang Thong & Bang Niang (Khao Lak)

items.name: The Sandy House Khaolak
items.meta: ★ 2-star · Best for: Budget · longer stays · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A family-run guesthouse in Bang Niang, about a 2-3 minute walk to the beach. Rooms are simple but clean, with air-con, a TV, a fridge, a balcony and hot water. There is an on-site minimart and motorbike rental. Reviews call it quiet and good value, and many suggest it for longer stays. A fit for budget travellers who want to be near the Bang Niang market and aren't fussy about polish.

items.name: Kokotel Khao Lak Lighthouse
items.meta: ★ 3-star · Best for: Budget · groups · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A modern 3-star hotel near the Khao Lak lighthouse landmark. Some rooms sleep up to six, which suits larger families or groups splitting the cost. It has an outdoor pool and a restaurant, and Nang Thong beach is walkable. Reviews praise friendly staff and the breakfast. A good fit for budget-minded travellers who still want a pool and tidy, well-run rooms.

items.name: Nang Thong Bay Resort
items.meta: ★ 3-star · Best for: Beachfront · good value · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A resort sitting right in the middle of Nang Thong beach, with bungalows and beachfront rooms and the sand just steps away. It has a pool near the beach, a restaurant and shaded gardens. Reviews score it around 8.9, praising the seafront location and the staff. A fit for couples or families who want a room by the beach at a mid-range price without paying 5-star rates.

items.name: Baan Khaolak Beach Resort
items.meta: ★ 4-star · Best for: Beachfront · families · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 4-star beachfront resort on Nang Thong, with family bungalows set in gardens, a pool and a seaside restaurant that reviews praise for good, reasonably priced food. The overall score is around 8.7. The draw is direct beach access and a well-kept property throughout. A fit for families who want to wake up to the sea and let the kids swim close by.

items.name: Khaolak Bhandari Resort and Spa
items.meta: ★ 4-star · Best for: Thai-style setting · couples · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A boutique 4-star resort with Thai-style decor, wooden bungalows set in green gardens, two lagoon pools and an adults-only area. It sits about a 5-minute walk from Nang Thong beach and roughly 10 minutes from the shops. Reviews score it highly at around 4.6/5, praising spacious rooms, the breakfast and the staff. A fit for couples who want a leafy Thai atmosphere and some quiet.

items.name: La Vela Khao Lak
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Beachfront · couples · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 5-star beachfront resort on Bang Niang, with a modern design inspired by the ancient Takola seaport. It has several pools, a beach club, a spa and sea-view rooms. Reviews score it around 9.3, praising the seafront spot, the breakfast and the seafood buffet, and you can walk to the Bang Niang night market without a taxi. A fit for couples or families who want a 5-star beachfront stay at a still-reachable price.

items.name: The Sands Khao Lak by Katathani
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Families · waterpark · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A large 5-star beachfront resort on Nang Thong with over 400 rooms. The standout is a waterpark with slides and a lazy river, plus a kids' club, which makes it a popular family pick. The sand is walkable and the Nang Thong shops are close. Reviews praise the cleanliness and spacious rooms. A fit for families with children who want the kids to swim all day without leaving the resort.

faq.q: Should I stay at Nang Thong or Bang Niang?
faq.a: Both are in the same zone and walkable to each other. Nang Thong is busier, with denser restaurants and shops, so it's handy if you want to walk to food easily. Bang Niang is a touch quieter but has the night market and several nice beachfront resorts. Pick Nang Thong for convenience, or Bang Niang for a more relaxed feel with the market close by.

faq.q: Is it easy to get around Khao Lak, and do I need to rent a vehicle?
faq.a: Khao Lak has no real public transport and no regular songthaew routes like bigger towns. Getting around mostly means renting a scooter or car, or calling a taxi or hotel transfer. Within the Nang Thong-Bang Niang strip you can walk comfortably, but for the Similan Islands pier, waterfalls, or Phuket airport (about an hour away), having your own wheels is far more convenient and better value.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Khao Lak, and is the rainy season worth it?
faq.a: The best window is November to April, when the sea is calm, the water is clear, and boats to the Similan Islands run (the Similan park usually opens roughly mid-October to mid-May). The rainy season from May to October brings stronger surf, some resort closures, and paused island tours, but the upside is much cheaper rooms and fewer people. If you come in the rainy months, check first that the hotel and tours you want are open.
